full_judgment: 3. Vis-a-vis; the contrary case of the defendants who are the petitioners of this revisional application in short is thus, that they never entered into any contract for sale of the suit land with the plaintiffs for transfer of the suit property which is the homestead land and structure of the defendants and they never accepted Tk. 1550/- as earnest money. There was no contract between the parties in respect of the disputed property but the plaintiffs with an ill motive to grab the property filed the suit on false allegation. The further case of the defendants is such that they filed a pre-emption Miscellaneous Case being No.145 of 1973 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 against the kabla deed dated 04.04.1973 executed by the defendant No.4 and to defeat pre-emption the plaintiffs on the basis of a false oral contract filed the suit for specific performance of contract which is liable to be dismissed.
